# lockfile-digests: subresource-integrity digests as they appear in a JSON lock file.
# these are not credentials. they are recorded here because a lock file is skipped by its name,
# and once such a line appears anywhere else its shape is indistinguishable from a packed token.
# if the exemption layer ever learns the sha256- prefix, this file loses these lines and
# false_positives/lockfile-hash-line-shapes.txt gains them: that move is a deliberate decision.
# format: <rule id> TAB <line>.
generic-high-entropy-value	    "integrity": "sha256-{B64_44}"
generic-high-entropy-value	integrity = "sha256-{B64_44}"
